resources.string: Ready. Open Phone Voice Commands on your Pebble and speak a command.
Allow Contacts to call or text people by name, Phone to place calls, and SMS to send texts straight from the watch. Each one is optional.
Android only lets this app open the clock and other apps from the background once your Pebble is linked to it. Android lists nearby Pebble watches; choose yours and allow it.
